sloka: स कृत्वा तु उदकम् तूर्णम् तापसः सह भार्यया ।माम् उवाच महा तेजाः कृत अन्जलिम् उपस्थितम् ॥२-६४-५२॥
transliteration: sa kṛtvā tu udakam tūrṇam tāpasaḥ saha bhāryayā ।mām uvāca mahā tejāḥ kṛta anjalim upasthitam ॥2-64-52॥

translations.english: The radiant ascetic along with his wife hurriedly completed the funeral libations and said to me standing with folded palms:
